page.title: Table QR codes
page.description: Every table gets its own QR code. Guests scan it to browse the live menu, order and call the waiter.
page.loadErrorTitle: Could not load the QR menu
page.stale: Showing the last known data. The latest refresh failed.

tables.emptyBody: Add dining areas and tables under Floor and tables. Each table then gets a QR code here.
tables.masterOff: The guest menu is switched off for the whole restaurant. Scanning any QR code shows a closed notice.
tables.localNote: This app is open on a local address. QR codes made here only work on this computer. Open Nexus from your real web address before printing.

card.pngAria: Download the QR code of table {{code}} as PNG

card.disableAria: Turn the guest menu off for table {{code}}

rotate.title: Replace the QR code for {{code}}?
rotate.body: A new secret link is created for table {{code}}. This cannot be undone.
rotate.effectOld: The current QR code stops working immediately.
rotate.effectPrint: Every printed card or table tent for this table must be replaced with a new print.

print.title: Print QR cards

sheet6.name: A4 sheet, 6 per page
sheet6.hint: Large cards, 2 by 3. Best for table stands.

sheet8.name: A4 sheet, 8 per page
sheet8.hint: Compact cards, 2 by 4. Cut along the dashed lines.

tent.name: Table tent, 100 mm wide
tent.hint: One card per page for a tent or acrylic holder.

print.includeDisabled: Include tables that are switched off
print.nothing: No table to print. Turn on at least one table.
print.localWarning: This app is open on a local address, so these codes will not open on guests' phones. Print from your real web address.
print.previewLabel: Preview of the first printed page
print.hint: Browse the menu, order from your seat, or call your waiter.

settings.masterHint: Turn off to close the menu on every table at once.
settings.orderingTitle: When a guest sends an order

off.name: Browse only
off.hint: Guests see the menu but cannot order.

confirm.name: Waiter confirms
confirm.hint: Orders wait in the Guest orders inbox until staff accept them.

auto.name: Auto-confirm
auto.hint: Orders go straight to the kitchen without a check.

settings.autoWarning: With auto-confirm nobody checks an order before the kitchen sees it. Use it only when the floor is closely watched.
settings.callWaiterHint: Guests can ask for service from their phone.
settings.upiHint: Guests see the bill and a UPI QR. Staff still confirm every payment.
settings.upiLink: Set the restaurant UPI ID under Configuration
settings.logoHint: Square image, shown on the menu header and printed cards.
settings.coverHint: Wide photo behind the restaurant name.
settings.imageFailed: Could not save the image. Please try again.
settings.accentHint: Used for buttons and highlights on the guest menu. Leave empty to use the restaurant colour.
settings.accentInvalid: Use a 6-digit hex code such as #22c55e.

preview.label: Preview of the guest menu on a phone
preview.note: Approximate preview. Updates as you type.

help.dish: Dish photos are shown at 4:5 (portrait). Drag to position, zoom to frame the dish.
help.logo: The logo is shown as a square. Drag to position, zoom to fit.
help.cover: The cover is shown wide (16:9). Drag to position, zoom to frame.

crop.keys: Arrow keys move the picture. Plus and minus zoom.
crop.small: This picture is small and may look soft on large phones. A bigger photo gives a sharper menu.
crop.unreadable: This file could not be read as a picture. Try another one.
crop.failed: Could not prepare the picture. Try another file.
crop.tooBig: The cropped picture is still {{size}}. Try a smaller original.

photos.tip: Photos are cropped to 4:5 and resized for fast phones. JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 12 MB. Drop a file on any card or use Upload.
photos.emptyBody: Add dishes under Menu, then add their photos here.
photos.loadError: Could not load the menu items
photos.dropHint: Drop a photo or tap to add
photos.uploadFailed: The photo was not saved. Please try again.
photos.removeBody: Guests will see the dish without a photo. You can add one again any time.

problem.type: {{name}}: only JPEG, PNG or WebP pictures can be used.
problem.size: {{name}}: that file is larger than 12 MB.

alerts.title: Waiter requests
alerts.doneAria: Mark the request from table {{table}} as handled

sound.locked: Your browser needs one tap before it can play the chime.

orders.title: Guest orders
orders.description: Orders guests place from their table QR code. Accept to send them to the kitchen.
orders.emptyBody: New orders from table QR codes appear here the moment they are placed, with a chime.
orders.stale: Showing the last known orders. The latest refresh failed.
orders.editAria: Edit the order from table {{table}} before accepting
orders.accepted: Order from table {{table}} accepted and sent to the kitchen.
orders.alreadyHandled: Another staff member already handled this order. The list has been refreshed.
orders.acceptFailed: Could not accept the order. It is still waiting.
orders.rejectFailed: Could not reject the order. It is still waiting.
orders.editFailed: Could not save the changes. The order is unchanged.
orders.rejectBody: The guest sees that the order was not accepted, with your reason.

rejectReasons.busy: The kitchen is too busy right now
rejectReasons.wrongTable: The table is not open yet

orders.rejectDetail: Add a note for the guest (optional)
orders.editBody: Change quantities (0 removes an item), then accept. The guest sees the updated order.
orders.removeAll: Every item is removed. Reject the order instead.
